meta.name: rItlh Qorwagh
meta.description: mI'naghmey tIwIv, rItlhlu'bogh Qorwagh yIchenmoH, 'ej wa'maH may'meyDaq ngoQmeylIj tItlha'. cha'vo' vagh QujwI'pu'; quSmey teblaH De'wI' QujwI'pu'.

echo.text: QorwaghlIjDaq wa' pagh cha' mI'nagh tIvIHmoH: wa' rItlh neH, may' tlheghDaq qaSbogh rItlh. Hoch lan chut yIlob.
